svg.title: Fee-cap sensitivity before choosing a market
svg.desc: diagram id: diag-04-jurisdiction-fee-caps; chart type: horizontal_bars; title: Fee-cap sensitivity before choosing a market; subtitle: Hypothetical legal ceilings, not a state-law comparison; chapter number: 2; epistemic tag: illustrative_model; assumptions note: Percent of a $40,000 recovery. A-D are hypothetical jurisdictions; no bar states an actual legal limit. Replace only after current legal review.; caption: Identical recoveries can support different maximum fees; timing restrictions can make an agreement unavailable regardless of percentage.; stages: label: Hypothetical A; value: 5% / $2,000; numeric value: 5.0; detail: Assumed ceiling only; agreement eligibility still requires review.; label: Hypothetical B; value: 10% / $4,000; numeric value: 10.0; detail: Assumed ceiling, not a recommendation to charge the maximum.; label: Hypothetical C; value: 15% / $6,000; numeric value: 15.0; detail: Assumed ceiling; the allowable compensation base may differ.; label: Hypothetical D; value: 20% / $8,000; numeric value: 20.0; detail: Assumed ceiling; expense reimbursement can also be regulated.
